title: Private Academy (Hagwon) Establishment Registration in Korea: Requirements & Procedure | YouSun Administrative Agency
h1: Private Academy (Hagwon) Establishment & Operation Registration in Korea
lead: To set up and run a private academy (hagwon) in Korea you must prepare the facilities and equipment and register with the Superintendent of Education (in practice, the district office of education) by submitting the registration application with the required documents; the application form states a processing period of 8 days and no fee. (Law status as of 2026-10-02, per law.go.kr.)
summary: Scope: a facility that teaches knowledge, skills or arts under a course of 30 days or more to a set number of learners or the general public.
Registered with: the Superintendent of Education (district office of education).
Facilities: unit facility standards set by city/province ordinance by course (fire-safety facilities follow fire laws).
Form: processing period 8 days; no fee.
Operating without registration: up to 1 year's imprisonment or a fine of up to KRW 10 million.

sections.body: A hagwon is a private facility that teaches knowledge, skills or arts under a course of 30 days or more to learners at or above a set number, or to an unspecified public. The set number is 10 persons who can be taught or use the study space at the same time. Academies are classified as school-curriculum academies and lifelong/vocational education academies. Anyone setting up and running one must register with the Superintendent of Education, stating the founder's details, courses, instructor list, tuition and facilities in the application.

(1) Facilities: facilities and equipment needed for teaching and learning must be provided and maintained according to unit facility standards set by city/province ordinance for each course, and fire-safety facilities follow fire laws.

(2) Course structure: a course made up of theory subjects and experiment/practice subjects cannot be split to set up separate academies.

(3) Disqualification: persons under adult or limited guardianship, undischarged bankrupts, persons less than 3 years past completing a sentence of imprisonment or on a suspended sentence, persons less than 1 year past a fine for violating this Act, and persons less than 1 year past cancellation of an academy registration (including the representative of a corporation) cannot register; the same applies if an officer of a corporation falls under these grounds. If a disqualification ground arises after registration, the registration loses effect (with an exception for corporations that replace the officer within 3 months).

(4) Refusal: registration may be refused if you apply within 1 year of a registration cancellation to run the same course at the same place.

The application states the founder's details, academy name and location, type and courses, capacity, instructor list, tuition and facilities, and planned opening date, and is submitted with the academy rules and documents to the Superintendent. The academy rules cover matters such as the name, purpose and location.

Attachments: (1) the academy rules, (2) a floor plan, (3) articles of incorporation and board minutes on establishment (corporations only), and (4) proof of the right to use the premises. The officer checks the building register and the resident register extract (individuals) or the corporate registry (corporations) through shared administrative information, and an electrical safety inspection certificate for applicable facilities.

(1) Plan courses, instructors, tuition and facilities → (2) prepare facilities and equipment → (3) submit the application, rules and documents → (4) registration is accepted if the facility standards and educational environment are met → (5) the registration certificate is issued and must be posted at the academy. Instructors' personal details must be posted, and instructors must meet the qualifications set by decree.
The application form states a processing period of 8 days. Time for facility work and course preparation is separate; confirm the actual period with the receiving office of education.
The Superintendent of Education; in practice, the district office of education with jurisdiction over the academy's location.

The registration application form states that there is no fee. (Form under the Enforcement Rule effective 2026-07-16. Private service fees are not statutory fees and are excluded; document issuance and other costs are separate.)

sections.h2: Why is a registration rejected or supplementation requested?
sections.body: Reasons confirmed in the law: facilities or educational environment not meeting the standards, a disqualification ground, re-registering the same course at the same place within 1 year of cancellation, splitting theory and practice courses, or missing attachments such as the floor plan or proof of use rights. Running an academy without registration can lead to up to 1 year's imprisonment or a fine of up to KRW 10 million.

sections.h2: What can an administrative agent help with?
sections.body: YouSun Administrative Agency prepares and submits application or report documents on your authorization. Work restricted by other laws cannot be handled, and litigation or court representation is outside the scope of an administrative agent and is not offered. Approval, registration or acceptance, and the outcome, are decided by the competent authority.

faq.q: How is an academy different from a tutoring studio?
faq.a: An academy teaches at least 10 learners at a time or an unspecified public for 30 days or more, while tutoring studios and private tutors are separate notification categories not covered on this page.

faq.q: What is needed to hire a foreign instructor for a language academy?
faq.a: Collect and verify a criminal record certificate, a health certificate issued within 1 month (including cannabis/drug test) and a degree certificate before hiring, plus copies of the passport and visa. Holders of a conversation-instruction status may be exempted from the criminal record certificate.

faq.q: What if I move the academy or change the operator?
faq.a: A change of operator, location, or facilities and equipment requires a change registration, and changes to courses, instructor list or tuition are also registered.

faq.q: How do I report suspension or closure?
faq.a: If suspending for 1 month or more, or closing, report to the Superintendent without delay.
The application form states no fee.

faq.q: What happens with the registration certificate?
faq.a: Once accepted, a registration certificate is issued and must be posted at the academy.

faq.q: Who decides whether an application is approved?
faq.a: The competent authority decides. The administrative agent supports document preparation and submission for applications or reports.
